title: Development and validation of an explainable neural network model for predicting progression in type 2 diabetic kidney disease
summary: An explainable neural-network model predicted progression of type 2 diabetic kidney disease from clinical indicators, with development and validation reported; findings are retrospective and cohort-bound.
ai_technology: An explainable neural network uses clinical indicators to predict progression of type 2 diabetic kidney disease.
organization: Jin hua Graduate Joint Training Base, Zhejiang Chinese Medical University, China; The Quzhou Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University, Quzhou People’s Hospital, China; Department of Nephrology, Quzhou Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, China

evidence.tested: An explainable neural-network model predicted progression of type 2 diabetic kidney disease from clinical indicators, with development and validation reported; findings are retrospective and cohort-bound.
